title: Listening Drill — Tour of a radio station — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Tour of a radio station — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on tour of a radio station last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with busy corridors. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: faulty door.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of visitor group so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow guest badge instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the studio host before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Sunday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
